verdict.rationale:
Clerk documents M2M tokens as a distinct machine-identity mechanism for agent-to-agent calls, separate from user credentials, and describes gating individual 'eve' tool calls against the caller's scoped permissions (clerk-docs-11, clerk-docs-16/27), which matches the least-privilege machine-identity story. However, evidence does not explicitly confirm instant revocation of M2M/agent tokens specifically (only session/device revocation for human users is documented), and the M2M feature is only lightly described via pricing-page mention rather than full docs.

missing for 10: explicit documentation of instant/immediate revocation for M2M agent tokens, deeper docs on scope granularity for machine identities, independent/hands-on validation of the eve agent-auth feature.
